notes: Behaviour changes, no signature changes. transferEncoding: 7bit when all body bytes < 0x80, else 8bit (line-length limits of RFC 2045 are not checked, as before). Message-ID: the first Message-ID in additionalHeaders is parsed with RFC_5322.Message.ID(_:) and used; invalid one throws Email.ConversionError.messageID; without one a random ID is generated as before. Tests: new 'Tests/Email Standard Tests/Email.Body Tests.swift' plus three tests in 'Email RFC 5322 Tests.swift'. README lines on 7bit and Message-ID updated (second commit).
